content: {"episode_id":"ep-05089","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-22","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-22 denial of CPT 93229 for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness that are concerning for arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency, consistent with diagnosis codes I34.0, R00.2, and R42. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate these symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias. We request reconsideration of the $709.93 balance on medical necessity grounds."}
